0.name: TEXT_DUNGEONHALATALI_00000_BRONZEBULL_000_000
0.description: The final test shall pit you against the finest gladiators ever to grace the bloodsands! Steel yourselves!
0.translation_description: L'ultima prova vi opporrà ai migliori gladiatori mai scesi nelle sabbie insanguinate! Preparatevi!

1.name: TEXT_DUNGEONHALATALI_00000_BRONZEBULL_000_001
1.description: A glorious contest! I was hard-pressed to restrain myself from joining the fray!
1.translation_description: Una gara gloriosa! Mi è costato fatica trattenermi dall'unirmi allo scontro!
